meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browser automation for AI agents via inference.sh. Navigate web pages, interact with elements using @e refs, take screenshots, record video. Capabilities: web scraping, form filling, clicking, typing, drag-drop, file upload, JavaScript execution. Use for: web automation, data extraction, testing, agent browsing, research. Triggers: browser, web automation, scrape, navigate, click, fill form, screenshot, browse web, playwright, headless browser, web agent, surf internet, record video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 代理自动浏览网页、提取信息或执行操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and data extraction via a scripted agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to navigate web pages, extract data, or perform actions autonomously

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可操控真实浏览器:打开网页,用 @e 编号定位元素并点击、填写、拖拽等,也能截图、录视频、执行 JavaScript;状态在会话内保留,操作后需重新获取页面快照。
howto.when: 当提到“browser”“web automation”“scrape”等触发词,或要求导航、点击、截图等网页操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,列出页面上可交互的元素
say.note: 会启动浏览器会话并返回带 @e 编号的元素清单

say.text: 把第一个输入框填成 abc@example.com,再点击提交按钮
say.note: 会执行 fill 和 click 操作

say.text: 给我当前页面的整页截图
say.note: 会调用 screenshot 并截取整页

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a real browser via infsh: open pages, use @e refs to click, fill, drag, etc., and also take screenshots, record video, or run JS. Browser state persists per session; re-snapshot after navigation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions keywords like browser, web automation, scrape, or asks to navigate, click, or take screenshots.

say_en.text: Open example.com and list the interactive elements on the page
say_en.note: Starts a browser session and returns elements with @e refs

say_en.text: Fill the first input with abc@example.com and click the submit button
Take a full-page screenshot of the current page
